notes: Only the advertised tools were judged. Several travel-listing tools are marked `UNTRUSTED` with `undetermined: true` because the code shows they return third-party-style listing/review fields but does not establish provenance or attacker control.

cancel_calendar_event.rationale: Marks an existing calendar event canceled and sends a fixed cancellation email to the event's existing participants. The output is only a fixed success string containing the input `event_id`; the recipient set is read from the existing event rather than supplied directly in the call.

check_restaurant_opening_hours.rationale: Returns restaurant names and `operating_hours` from `restaurants.restaurant_list`. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

create_calendar_event.rationale: Creates a calendar event, appends the calendar owner email via `participants.append(self.account_email)`, stores it, and returns the `CalendarEvent`, exposing account calendar data. It also sends an email to caller-supplied `participants` with caller-supplied `title`/`description` and the event attachment via `inbox.send_email`, so it is a SINK.

get_all_car_rental_companies_in_city.rationale: Returns car rental company names from a third-party-looking listing. The code does not establish who controls company records, so returned names are treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_all_hotels_in_city.rationale: Returns hotel names from a third-party-looking hotel listing (`hotels.hotel_list`). The code does not establish who controls hotel records, so the attacker-controllability of returned names is undetermined; keeping `UNTRUSTED`.

get_all_restaurants_in_city.rationale: Returns restaurant names from a third-party-looking restaurant listing. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so returned names are treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_car_fuel_options.rationale: Returns car rental company names and fuel options from `car_rental.company_list`. The code does not establish who controls company records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_car_price_per_day.rationale: Returns entries keyed by `company.name` from the car rental listing. The code does not establish who controls company records, so company-name text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_car_rental_address.rationale: Returns car rental company names and addresses from `car_rental.company_list`. The code does not establish who controls company records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_car_types_available.rationale: Returns car rental company names and available car types from `car_rental.company_list`. The code does not establish who controls company records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_contact_information_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant names and `contact_information` from `restaurants.restaurant_list`. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant names and cuisine values from `restaurants.restaurant_list`. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_day_calendar_events.rationale: Returns the user's calendar events for a day, exposing private event data. Event titles/descriptions/locations may be authored by outside participants, but the code does not settle provenance, so `UNTRUSTED` is kept.

get_dietary_restrictions_for_all_restaur.rationale: Returns restaurant names and dietary restriction text from `restaurants.restaurant_list`. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_flight_information.rationale: Returns flight listing text from `flights.flight_list`, including airline, flight number, price, and contact information. The code does not establish who controls flight records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_hotels_address.rationale: Returns hotel names and addresses from `hotels.hotel_list`. The code does not establish who controls hotel records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_hotels_prices.rationale: Returns entries keyed by `hotel.name` from the hotel listing. The code does not establish who controls hotel records, so hotel-name text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_price_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns entries keyed by `restaurant.name` from the restaurant listing. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so restaurant-name text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_rating_reviews_for_car_rental.rationale: Returns car rental ratings and joins `company.reviews`; reviews are third-party review text and may contain attacker-authored content. The code does not constrain review provenance.

get_rating_reviews_for_hotels.rationale: Returns hotel ratings and joins `hotel.reviews`; reviews are third-party review text and may contain attacker-authored content. The code does not constrain review provenance.

get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants.rationale: Returns restaurant ratings and joins `restaurant.reviews`; reviews are third-party review text and may contain attacker-authored content. The code does not constrain review provenance.

get_restaurants_address.rationale: Returns restaurant names and addresses from `restaurants.restaurant_list`. The code does not establish who controls restaurant records, so returned listing text is treated as potentially attacker-controlled.

get_user_information.rationale: Returns personal data from the user's `User` dependency, including ID number, email, phone, address, passport number, bank account number, and credit card number via `get_user_information`.

reserve_car_rental.rationale: Mutates the local `reservation` dependency using the selected company and times and returns a confirmation string. The code does not send the reservation to an external party.

reserve_hotel.rationale: Mutates the local `reservation` dependency using the selected hotel and dates and returns a confirmation string. The code does not send the reservation to an external party.

reserve_restaurant.rationale: Mutates the local `reservation` dependency using the selected restaurant and time and returns a confirmation string. The code does not send the reservation to an external party.

search_calendar_events.rationale: Searches and returns events from the user's calendar, including event titles, descriptions, times, locations, and participants, so it exposes private calendar data. Calendar event text may originate from other participants/invitations; the code does not settle provenance, so `UNTRUSTED` is kept.

send_email.rationale: Sends caller-supplied `subject`, `body`, and optional attachments to caller-supplied `recipients`, `cc`, and `bcc`, so it is a SINK. It returns the created `Email`, whose `sender` is the user's `account_email` from the inbox dependency, exposing account data not provided in the call.
